File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Update ExportButton to read and write the last used export format from localStorage, so user preference for the export format is preserved across sessions.
args.title: Persist export format choice in localStorage

args.body:
label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton currently initializes its format state using defaultFormat without persisting or retrieving the user's previously chosen format. Updating the component to read and write the last used export format from localStorage will provide a better user experience across sessions.
